cards.card_text: Leprous and white as snow Burned and black as coal Shining bright as the sun
cards.verse_text: Furthermore, the LORD said to Moses, “Put your hand inside your cloak.” So he put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, his hand was leprous, white as snow.
cards.snippet: …inside his cloak, and when he took it out, his hand was leprous, white as snow.

cards.card_text: As the cloud lifts from above the Tent, suddenly Miriam is leprous, white as snow.
cards.verse_text: As the cloud lifted from above the Tent, suddenly Miriam became leprous, white as snow.
cards.snippet: As the cloud lifted from above the Tent, suddenly Miriam became leprous, white as snow.

cards.card_text: And as Gehazi leaves Elisha's presence, he is leprous, as white as snow.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and your descendants forever!” And as Gehazi left his presence, he was leprous—as white as snow.
cards.snippet: …and your descendants forever!” And as Gehazi left his presence, he was leprous—as white as snow.

cards.card_text: The priests see Uzziah's leprous forehead and rush him out of the temple.
cards.verse_text: When Azariah the chief priest and all the priests turned to him and saw his leprous forehead, they rushed him out.
cards.snippet: …chief priest and all the priests turned to him and saw his leprous forehead, they rushed him out.
